article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: Minutes of the Council of Ministers meeting held on Thursday, 19 November 2026
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina: compte rendu du Conseil des ministres du jeudi 19 novembre 2026
article_manifest.summary: The Council of Ministers met in Ouagadougou on Thursday, 19 November 2026, in an ordinary session, from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m., under the chairmanship of Comrade Captain Ibrahim TRAORE, President of Burkina Faso, President of the Council of Ministers. It deliberated on the items on its agenda, heard oral reports, made appointments, and authorised missions abroad.

article_manifest.title: France: Lecornu warns of a high level of cyber threat and announces enhanced security measures
article_manifest.original_title: France : Lecornu alerte sur un niveau de cybermenace et annonce un renforcement des mesures de sécurité
article_manifest.summary: “We are facing a level of threat that is unprecedented, with an intensity we have never experienced before,” said Vincent Strubel, Director General of ANSSI. On Thursday, 19 November, the French Prime Minister, Sébastien Lecornu, warned of an intensification of cyberattacks targeting companies and public institutions, describing the level of threat as “particularly serious and unprecedented”.

article_manifest.title: Erdogan: “With the Bayraktar Kızılelma, our army will go from victory to victory”
article_manifest.original_title: Erdogan: « Avec le Bayraktar Kızılelma, notre armée ira de victoire en victoire »
article_manifest.summary: “Our Bayraktar Kızılelma unmanned combat aircraft has been added to the inventory of the Turkish Armed Forces following years of work and great effort,” said the Turkish head of state. On Thursday, President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan announced that the Bayraktar Kızılelma unmanned combat aircraft has been added to the inventory of the Turkish Armed Forces. .

article_manifest.title: DIRECTORATE OF MILITARY COLLEGES: The 2026–2027 academic year at the Military Colleges has officially begun
article_manifest.original_title: DIRECTION DES ÉCOLES MILITAIRES : la rentrée académique 2026-2027 des Ecoles Militaires officiellement lancée
article_manifest.summary: On Thursday, 19 November 2026, the parade ground of the Boubacar Sada SY Training Centre in Koulikoro hosted the formal ceremony marking the start of the 2026–2027 academic year for the Military Colleges. The ceremony was presided over by the Director of Military Colleges, Brigadier General Moussa Yoro Kanté, in the presence of several military and administrative officials, senior officers, and students and trainees from the various training establishments.

article_manifest.title: Mali: The Malian army announces the release of 24 soldiers during a special operation near Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : l’armée malienne annonce la libération de 24 soldats lors d’une opération spéciale près de Kidal
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Malian Armed Forces announced the release, on Wednesday, 18 November, of twenty-four (24) soldiers from the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) who had been held hostage in the Kidal region, following an air-land operation. The operation took place on Wednesday, 18 November, at around 1 p.m. in the In-Tebezas area, located approximately 110 kilometres southeast of Kidal.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: KAYES: A NEW CONVOY OF TANKERS ARRIVES UNDER FAMa ESCORT
article_manifest.original_title: KAYES : UN NOUVEAU CONVOI DE CAMIONS-CITERNES ARRIVE SOUS ESCORTE DES FAMa
article_manifest.summary: Kayes, 19 November (AMAP) – A new convoy of fuel tankers arrived in the city of Kayes on Thursday, 19 November 2020, escorted by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), announced the Regional Directorate of the General Directorate for Trade, Consumer Affairs and Competition (DGCC). According to the same source, these petroleum products are intended to supplement the stocks already available at service stations and points of sale in the region.

article_manifest.title: Analysis: Russia's "Africa Corps" uses a new drone as operations escalate in Mali
article_manifest.original_title: تحليل: "فيلق إفريقيا" الروسي يستخدم طائرة مسيرة جديدة مع تصاعد العمليات في مالي
article_manifest.summary: A new analysis, seen by Reuters, has revealed that the Russian Africa Corps forces operating in Mali deployed a new type of armed drone this year, at a time when they intensified their airstrikes in an attempt to regain the momentum they lost following an attack by extremist and separatist militants in April.

article_manifest.title: The International Crisis Group recommends negotiations between the Sahelian military regimes and JNIM
article_manifest.original_title: International Crisis Group recommande des négociations entre les régimes militaires sahéliens et le Jnim
article_manifest.summary: . "The Battle for the Cities: Countering the JNIM Threat to Sahel Urban Centres" is the title of the report published this Friday, 20 November, by the International Crisis Group (ICG), a non-governmental research organisation specialising in conflict prevention and analysis. .

article_manifest.title: Gao: One dead and three injured in an explosive device blast in Edang
article_manifest.original_title: Gao : un mort et trois blessés dans l’explosion d’un engin explosif à Edang
article_manifest.summary: One child lost his life and three people were seriously injured, including two children, in the explosion of an explosive device this Thursday at around 3 p.m. in the village of Edang, Anchawadj commune, Gao region. According to local sources, children are said to have picked up the device before handing it over to a scrap metal dealer.

It deliberated on the items on its agenda, heard oral reports, made appointments, and authorised missions abroad.

article_manifest.title: Kayes: A new convoy of tanker trucks boosts hydrocarbon stocks
article_manifest.original_title: Kayes: Un nouveau convoi de camions citernes renforce les stocks d’hydrocarbures
article_manifest.summary: Kayes, 19 November (AMAP) The City of Railways has just witnessed the arrival, this Thursday, of a new convoy of tanker trucks, escorted by our valiant Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), who were once again commended by the Regional Directorate of Trade for their commitment and courage, as reported by AMAP. “These products supplement the stocks already available at service stations and points of sale, and confirm the continuity and regularity of fuel supplies throughout the Kayes Region”, said the Regional Director of Trade.

article_manifest.title: AES: Burkinabe officers on a study visit to Mali to strengthen military cooperation
article_manifest.original_title: AES : des officiers burkinabè en visite d'étude au Mali pour renforcer la coopération militaire
article_manifest.summary: Trainees from the Staff College of Burkina Faso arrived at Modibo-Keïta International Airport in Sénou, Bamako, on Thursday, 19 November 2026. The group is led by Colonel-Major Céleste Joseph Moussa Coulibaly, Commandant of the Higher Military Education Institute. .

article_manifest.title: Niger: What we know about the fuel convoy escorted by Algeria
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: ce que l’on sait du convoi de carburant escorté par l’Algérie
article_manifest.summary: A few days after the vote on 25 October 2023 in the Algerian Parliament approving the dispatch of military units to Niger to “secure energy interests”, a first fuel convoy, accompanied by a military escort, entered Niger, heading towards Agadez, in the north of the country. . During the few days of confirmed Algerian military presence on the ground, a lot of fake news spread on social media.

article_manifest.title: Putin rules out any ceasefire negotiations with Ukraine after the attack on the Crimean Bridge
article_manifest.original_title: Poutine exclut toute négociation de cessez-le-feu avec l’Ukraine après l’attaque contre le pont de Crimée
article_manifest.summary: The Russian President promises a “much more painful” response to the attack on the Crimean Bridge, whose road section was seriously damaged. Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Thursday that Moscow would not negotiate a ceasefire with Ukraine following the “serious attacks” on the Crimean Bridge. .

article_manifest.title: AES: Mali welcomes the second class of the Burkina Faso Staff College
article_manifest.original_title: AES : le Mali accueille la deuxième promotion de l’École d’Etat-major du Burkina Faso
article_manifest.summary: The second class of the Burkina Faso Staff College arrived at Modibo-KEÏTA International Airport in Sénou, Bamako, on Thursday, 19 November 2026. Led by the Commandant of the Institute of Higher Military Education of Burkina Faso, Colonel-Major Céleste Joseph Moussa COULIBALY, the delegation was welcomed by Colonel-Major Drissa Salifou DEMBÉLÉ, Deputy Chief of Staff in charge of General Studies and External relations.

article_manifest.title: Djibril Bassolé, Mamadou Alpha Barry, Ahmed Newton Barry… In Burkina Faso, behind the accusations of ‘terrorism’, the hunt for critical voices
article_manifest.original_title: Djibril Bassolé, Mamadou Alpha Barry, Ahmed Newton Barry… Au Burkina Faso, derrière les accusations de « terrorisme », la chasse aux voix critiques
article_manifest.summary: Djibril Bassolé, Mamadou Alpha Barry, Ahmed Newton Barry… In Burkina Faso, behind the accusations of 'terrorism', the hunt for critical voices The Burkinabé judiciary has unveiled a series of proceedings targeting prominent figures based abroad. Accused of "complicity in terrorism", several of them denounce an offensive aimed at silencing opponents of Ibrahim Traoré's junta.

article_manifest.original_title: Kidal : l’armée annonce la libération de 24 militaires à In-Tebezas
article_manifest.summary: RIGHT NOW The announcement came on the evening of 18 November, a few hours after the operation carried out in an area southeast of Kidal. The soldiers in question were being held by an armed group whose identity has not been specified. The official account states that an aerial reconnaissance mission identified the place of detention and the armed positions.

article_manifest.title: Douentza: Rural women in the spotlight
article_manifest.original_title: Douentza : les femmes rurales à l’honneur
article_manifest.summary: This Thursday, the Maison des Arts et de la Culture in Douentza hosted a meeting dedicated to recognising the contribution of women to rural activities. Coming from the various municipalities and localities of the region, they displayed cereals from their own production. .

article_manifest.title: Gao: One dead and three injured in an explosive device blast in Edang
article_manifest.original_title: Gao : un mort et trois blessés dans l’explosion d’un engin explosif à Edang
article_manifest.summary: One child lost his life and three people were seriously injured, including two children, in the explosion of an explosive device on Thursday at around 3 p.m. in the village of Edang, Anchawadj commune, Gao region. According to local sources, children reportedly picked up the device before handing it over to a scrap metal dealer.

article_manifest.title: Mali: The FAMA free 24 soldiers held by terrorists in Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Les FAMA libèrent 24 soldats aux mains des terroristes à Kidal
article_manifest.summary: According to information reported by the Malian Press Agency (AMAP), the Malian Armed Forces (FAMA) carried out a military operation yesterday, Wednesday 18 November, in the In-Tebezas area, about 110 km southeast of Kidal. This offensive led to the release of 24 soldiers held hostage by armed terrorist groups. .

article_manifest.title: The Malian army announces the “killing” of armed men in airstrikes near Kidal and Nono
article_manifest.original_title: الجيش المالي يعلن “مقتل” مسلحين في ضربات جوية قرب كيدال ونونو
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army announced that it had carried out airstrikes targeting positions and gatherings of armed groups it described as terrorist in several areas, including the vicinity of Kidal and Nono. These strikes were part of Operation Dogokoloko and resulted in the deaths of several militants. In a statement issued on Thursday, 19 November, the army clarified that, with the support of its partners, the Malian Armed Forces had targeted a camp on Tuesday containing militants and logistical equipment, including motorcycles, located 15 kilometres southeast of Nono.

article_manifest.title: Niono, Sofara, Niafunké, Kidal: The army announces a series of strikes
article_manifest.original_title: Niono, Sofara, Niafunké, Kidal : l’armée annonce une série de frappes
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army is continuing its operations against armed terrorist groups. According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their partners carried out several strikes on 17 and 18 November 2026, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. 15 kilometres southeast of Niono, the army struck a terrorist camp .

article_manifest.title: Terrorism: Senegal calls for an AES-ECOWAS framework for collaboration
article_manifest.original_title: Terrorisme : Le Sénégal plaide pour un cadre de collaboration AES-CEDEAO
article_manifest.summary: The Chief of the General Staff of the Senegalese Armed Forces, who is also Chairman of the ECOWAS Committee of Chiefs of Staff, Vice Admiral Oumar Wade, reaffirmed Senegal's commitment to regional military cooperation, highlighting the importance of strategic dialogue, the sharing of experience and solidarity among West African armed forces. He considered that "political differences should not be an obstacle to West African armies in the face of a transnational terrorist threat".

article_manifest.title: Mali: 24 soldiers freed thanks to a special forces operation
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : 24 soldats libérés grâce à une opération des forces spéciales
article_manifest.summary: According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, this meticulously prepared joint operation began with an aerial reconnaissance mission that identified the positions of the terrorist groups as well as the location where the hostages were being held. Following precise intelligence, airstrikes were carried out in the area of In-Tebezas, a locality located around a hundred kilometres from the town of Kidal.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Counter-Terrorism: Strikes by the National Defence Forces in Several Parts of the Country
article_manifest.original_title: Lutte contre le Terrorisme: Frappes des Forces Nationales de Défense dans plusieurs localités du pays
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 19 November (AMAP) The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. Several positions and logistical resources of armed terrorist groups were targeted, with results deemed satisfactory, according to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces published on Thursday.

article_manifest.title: Mali: 24 soldiers released after airstrikes southeast of Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : 24 militaires libérés après des frappes aériennes au sud-est de Kidal
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army has announced the release of 24 of its soldiers who were being held in the In-Tebezas area, southeast of Kidal. The operation, carried out on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, involved air assets and ground troops. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) have announced a military operation that led to the release of 24 of their personnel who were being held in the In-Tebezas area, located about 110 kilometres southeast of Kidal.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: Several terrorist positions and resources targeted in Niono, Sofara, Niafunké and Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : plusieurs positions et ressources terroristes frappées à Niono, Sofara, Niafunké et Kidal
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national public that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. . On Tuesday, 17 November 2026, a camp belonging to armed terrorist groups, housing several individuals as well as logistical equipment, including motorcycles, was targeted by precision strikes fifteen (15) kilometres southeast of Niono.

article_manifest.title: Mali: 24 soldiers freed during an army operation near Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : 24 militaires libérés lors d’une opération de l’armée près de Kidal
article_manifest.summary: On Wednesday, 18 November 2026, the Malian army announced the release of 24 of its soldiers held in the In-Tebezas area, about 110 kilometres southeast of Kidal, following an operation combining airstrikes and ground troop intervention. According to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces, the operation was launched at around 1 p.m., following an aerial reconnaissance phase that enabled the positions of the armed groups to be located, as well as the site where the soldiers were being held.

article_manifest.title: Nigeria: Nigeria, Cameroon, Chad, Niger Reach Deal On Military Pursuit of Terrorists
article_manifest.original_title: Nigeria: Nigeria, Cameroon, Chad, Niger Reach Deal On Military Pursuit of Terrorists
article_manifest.summary: Nigeria and three neighbouring countries -- Cameroon, Chad and Niger -- have reportedly agreed to allow military forces to pursue terrorists, armed bandits and other criminal groups up to five kilometres across their shared borders. The arrangement is aimed at strengthening regional counterterrorism operations and preventing fleeing militants from escaping military pressure by crossing into neighbouring territories.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: Burkina Faso Targets Critics in Exile
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso: Burkina Faso Targets Critics in Exile
article_manifest.summary: Junta's Arrest Warrants, Extradition Requests Extend Crackdown Abroad Journalists, activists and political opponents who fled Burkina Faso to escape the junta's repression now risk arrest and prosecution abroad, as the country's judicial authorities pursue dozens of individuals over alleged terrorism-related offenses. Burkina Faso Prosecutor General Désiré Sawadogo announced on November 13 that a special court handling terrorism-related offenses had opened six cases against at least 45 people and entities.

article_manifest.title: Insecurity in the Dosso region: in Dioundou, the authorities denounce the involvement of "local children" in the recent series of massacres of civilians
article_manifest.original_title: Insécurité dans la région de Dosso : à Dioundou, les autorités dénoncent l’implication des « enfants du terroir » dans la récente série de massacres de civils
article_manifest.summary: Last weekend, the Governor of Dosso visited the people mourning a series of massacres of civilians perpetrated by members of the terrorist group 'Lakurawa' in several villages in the Dioundou Department, in the Dosso Region. .

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: Report of the Council of Ministers meeting held on Thursday, 19 November 2026
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : Compte rendu du conseil des ministres du jeudi 19 novembre 2026
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso: Report of the Council of Ministers of Thursday, 19 November 2026 The Council of Ministers met in Ouagadougou on Thursday, 19 November 2026, in an ordinary session, from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m., under the chairmanship of Comrade Captain Ibrahim Traoré, President of Burkina Faso and Chairman of the Council of Ministers. .
